items.title: The EV Bust Creating a New Battery Boom
items.title_ko: The EV Bust Creating a New Battery Boom
items.summary_ko: Factories built to supply America’s electric-vehicle boom are getting a second life making batteries for the power grid. As EV demand weakens and electricity demand from data centers and new factories strengthens, battery makers are shifting toward stationary storage, but the new market still relies on federal incentives and a supply chain that remains partly dependent on China.
